description: Byte-exact vendored copy of the canonical PC server TangMen level-data script. Runtime/tests consume these exact bytes; the factory builder and the level-data parity test are both derived from this source.

source.selection_rationale: lvlSetScript for every TangMen skill in PcTangMenSkills.txt is \script\skill\tangmen.lua; the evidenced canonical root for TangMen membership is /var/www/jx-source/01_tinh_kiem_source (same tree family as the hash-pinned Server skillbook.lua used by SKL-TM-PROOF-001). The bin/Server, bin/Server/Server, and bin/client copies under that root are byte-identical (sha256 3f2e7c2a...); the pak_unpacked/slistcache and repo cache/server_offline variants differ and are recorded as conflicting sources below.

conflicting_sources.note: Different build revision; not the evidenced canonical root.

Mobile shipped server_offline copy; a different build revision. Source conflict (documented, not silently resolved): for 19 of the 28 mapped skills the supported damage/state attributes are byte-identical to the vendored canonical source, but 9 skills have divergent supported-attr values -> 301 PoisonDamageV; 302 PhysicsEnhanceP/PoisonDamageV/SkillCostV; 339 PhysicsEnhanceP; 340 PhysicsEnhanceP; 341 DeadlyStrikeP/PhysicsEnhanceP/PoisonDamageV/SkillCostV; 342 DeadlyStrikeP/PhysicsEnhanceP/PoisonDamageV/SkillCostV; 351 ColdDamageV/FireDamageV/LightingDamageV/PhysicsDamageV/PoisonDamageV/SkillCostV; 352 same six; 1113 same six. The vendored jx-source canonical copy is selected per SKL-TM-PROOF-001 canonical-root evidence; the cache divergence is recorded as a source-conflict residual and must be reconciled before a PC-golden runtime claim.
